overview: The West Medford Community Center hosted its monthly Fresh Fridays Words and Music program, featuring a discussion on the center's leadership and upcoming initiatives followed by a musical performance.

items.title: Welcome and Poetry Reading
items.summary: Terry Carter opened the program with remarks on center activities and recited his poem 'Picket Fences' reflecting on neighborhood history and gentrification.

items.title: Conversation with Executive Director Lisa Crossman
items.summary: Executive Director Lisa Crossman discussed stepping into leadership, preparations for the center's 90th anniversary, launching the Circles USA poverty reduction initiative, and building sustainable funding.

items.title: Musical Performance by Donna McElroy
items.summary: Vocalist Donna McElroy performed a set of traditional hymns, spirituals, and jazz standards interspersed with personal reflections and storytelling.

items.title: Community Announcements and Closing
items.summary: Carter closed the evening by announcing upcoming events, including senior lunches, a vaccine clinic, and the holiday Black Vendor Fair.
